name: Dark iOS
tagline: Barty-Bart's explainer-engaging: a dark iOS surface, dot grid, one system blue, a one-take follow-cam with squash.

motion.direction: Barty-Bart engaging explainer. A dark iOS world: surfaces `mar` / `#2C2C2E`, text `iv`, secondary `goldd`, one system blue `ter`, a faint dot grid. ONE-TAKE follow-cam: no cuts, no fades to black — the camera glides from element to element (spring ω ≈ 6) and the thing it lands on reacts (squash 1.25 × 0.8 for 60 ms, reveal from 0.3× with 15–25° rotateX). `chips` as iOS pills, `lockCard` as a notification island, `counter` with tabular digits, `imageCard` with 22 px radius. No explanatory text overlays — the UI is the explanation; captions karaoke under the chin.
